Sample config
project_id: sample-platform-prod
region: us-central1
artifact_registry_repository: platform-services
caddy:
  enabled: true
services:
  - name: identity-grpc
    protocol: grpc
    caddy:
      domain: api.sample-platform.dev
      presets: [compression, security-headers]
  - name: analytics-worker
    profile: worker
Run locally
gcpgrlx validate -f .\examples\microservices.yaml
gcpgrlx plan -f .\examples\microservices.yaml
gcpgrlx render-caddy -f .\examples\microservices.yaml --stdout
gcpgrlx render -f .\examples\microservices.yaml -out .\dist
grlx cook .\dist\deploy.grlx -T gcp-runner --test
Generated deploy.grlx
name: gcpgrlx-cloud-run-deploy
states:
  - name: "Deploy identity-grpc"
    cmd.run:
      - name: "gcloud run deploy 'identity-grpc' ..."
  - name: "Deploy analytics-worker"
    cmd.run:
      - name: "gcloud run jobs deploy 'analytics-worker' ..."
  - name: "Apply Caddy configuration"
  - name: "Run smoke test: identity edge route"
